pictures.name: NB1-Ghats-Dawn
pictures.prompt: Varanasi at dawn, centuries ago: wide stone steps (ghats) descending to the misty Ganga river, temple spires and wooden boats. A young Hindu monk, about twenty, shaved head, saffron robe and a wooden staff, walks down a lane toward the river, followed by four young students in white and saffron cloth. Rose-gold sunrise, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: NB2-The-Stranger
pictures.prompt: A narrow stone lane in old Varanasi at dawn. Coming toward the viewer is a weathered laborer, about forty, sun-weathered and dignified, simple rough cloth wrapped at his waist and shoulder, a calm dignified face, with four lean village dogs walking beside him. Behind, out of focus, the young saffron-robed monk and his students approach. Warm light on his face. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame.
